body.caveat: Bounds carry their basis. EVIDENCED means read from a document in this bundle; ASSUMED_RANGE means a declared multiple rather than a reading, and is stated so it can never be mistaken for evidence; ZERO is the floor. UNBOUNDED means nothing here bounds it at all, so no interval and no percentage is shown. Statutory gaps get no interval because their consequence is a penalty and a deadline rather than a range of payouts. Every operand listed here will remain UNESTABLISHED until the document actually arrives — nothing on this page changes a finding.

body.method: Each unevidenced operand is ranked by the width of the exposure it leaves open, not by any guess at its value. An exposure nothing in the bundle bounds is reported as UNBOUNDED and ranked first, because a gap of unknown size is not a small one. This is a measure of what is not known — not a prediction of what the figure will turn out to be.
body.recommendation: Obtain: Reinstatement cost assessment. Nothing in the documents supplied bounds this exposure, so its size is unknown rather than small — which is why it is ranked above gaps that do carry a figure. Obtaining it would make building value proven rather than unestablished.

issues.headline: Your ACRA profile records an online activity, so you collect customer personal data. The operative sections on your schedule are PROPERTY, PUBLIC_LIABILITY — none of which responds to a data breach. Both figures are from an authority document and an insurer document, so this is a PROVEN absence rather than an assumption.

Your documents evidence 1 outside dependency/dependencies that your income relies on. The operative sections on your schedule are PROPERTY, PUBLIC_LIABILITY, which include no business interruption section. Cover for income lost when a supplier, utility or landlord fails is normally an extension to that section, so there is nothing for it to attach to.
Your work injury schedule declares 11 employees; the CPF contribution record shows 14. Both are third-party or insurer documents, so this is a PROVEN discrepancy.

At least one Work Permit holder carries medical insurance below the S$60,000 annual minimum required per migrant worker. Both figures are from the authority-authored work pass list, so this is a PROVEN discrepancy.

Two endorsements amend the food-and-drink liability sub-limit to different figures (END-03 = S$5000, END-04 = S$25000) at the same authority rank, with neither stating it supersedes the other. Precedence could not be established from the documents, so this is routed to a licensed adviser rather than resolved by the engine.

Business-interruption cover was searched for and not confirmed. The Schedule's operative sections list Property and Public/Products Liability only; no business interruption section is present in this variant. "Not confirmed" is not "not covered" — it states exactly what the reviewed documents do and do not show.

Your stock sum insured is below the level the policy's average condition requires. The stock value is self-authored (DECLARED), so under-insurance proportionately reduces any stock claim. The figure shown is an illustration — where the wording states no formula it is labelled market convention, never "amount payable".

absent_convention.because: With 4 sites and a payroll to meet every month, a stoppage costs money even when the damage itself is repaired. Businesses at this size commonly insure the lost income as well as the damage.

how_cbi_works.basis_caveat: These are common market structures, not terms of your policy. Your own wording governs, and where we have not read a term we say so.
how_cbi_works.named_basis: Where it exists, cover is commonly limited to suppliers named in the policy. Changing supplier without updating the policy can leave the new one outside cover.
how_cbi_works.physical_damage_basis: It conventionally responds only to physical damage at the supplier's own premises. A supplier that fails for any other reason causes the same loss of income and is conventionally outside the trigger.
how_cbi_works.structure: Supplier dependency cover is normally an extension to a business interruption section, so it cannot exist without one.

citations.finding: Where a condition precedent to liability is not satisfied and the policy does not spell out a remedy, common law principles apply and the insurer may be entitled to decline the claim entirely.
citations.source: Pinsent Masons, on conditions precedent under the Insurance Act 2015

citations.finding: For some conditions precedent, insurers may not have to pay the claim regardless of whether the breach had any causal connection to the loss.
citations.source: DLA Piper, Practical Guide for Claims Managers

why_this_matters.market_position: A search of the market found law-firm guidance on the principle and no product that tracks compliance for an in-force SME policy.
why_this_matters.note: Cover responding to a loss is not the same as a claim being paid. Warranties and conditions precedent sit between the two.
